text:
pagerbot: PAGER — Priority: P1 — Suspicious auth traffic on auth-proxy-prod (high token reuse + elevated 5xx). Sampled request ids -> https://grafana.redwood/prod/auth-proxy/streams/abc123 :rotating_light:

sre_amy: oncall here, seeing steady spike since ~10:12 UTC, 5xx from upstream auth service + repeated Authorization header patterns. Investigating.

observability_bot: Correlation: top-source-ips: 18.205.0.0/16, 52.34.12.145; err-rate +420% vs baseline. Resp codes 502/504. KV cache miss rate up 30%. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/prod/dashboards/zz-auth-anom

sec_ops_ben: @sre_amy can you gather a few sample headers (redact tokens) and paste here? I want to check for token format/issuer. Also starting a temporary block for suspicious CIDR if we confirm automated scraping.

oncall-frontend: grabbed samples and redacted, pasted to secure snippet: ```Authorization: Bearer <redacted:eyJhbGci...>\nUser-Agent: python-requests/2.28\nX-Forwarded-For: 52.34.12.145```

sec_ops_ben: those look like production tokens (same issuer claim). Potential replay / token scraping. I recommend immediate mitigation: 1) WAF rule to block noisy IPs, 2) rate-limit / challenge on auth-proxy, 3) rotate affected service token(s).

eng_pm_lee: any customer-facing impact? We need to know which tenants seeing failures before we rotate keys. Cust success must be notified if sessions drop.

cust_success_maya: two enterprise customers reported elevated 401/502 errors (acct: Optimo & DataLoop). Both reported degraded inference routing starting ~10:15. They're on Dedicated; may be hitting auth-proxy for control plane calls. I'll open a bridge with them after we have ETA.

sre_amy: applying short-term mitigations: 1) add IP block for 52.34.12.145, 2) enable 429 throttling for anonymous UA patterns. Rolling in now (no downtime expected). Notifying if rollback needed.

observability_bot: Deploy of WAF rule started: deploy-id wafr-2026-09-17-001. Watch link: https://deploy.redwood/wafr-2026-09-17-001.

sec_ops_ben: after WAF is live, plan rotation for service-account: "ingress-token-proxy". Steps: 1) create new key, 2) stage in proxy config, 3) warm connections, 4) cutover, 5) revoke old key. Estimated time ~15m with config rollouts. Any objections to rotating now?

oncall-frontend: WAF rule is live, immediate drop in requests from 52.34.12.145. Error rate overall down 18% so far. Proceed with rotation when ready.

sre_amy: agree to rotate. I'll coordinate the cutover window. Scheduling now.

sec_ops_ben: rotation commands (internal): ```# create new SA key
rbacctl create-key --service ingress-token-proxy --output /tmp/new.key
# stage in proxy config (k8s secret)
kubectl -n infra set secret generic ingress-proxy-key --from-file=key=/tmp/new.key --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
# rollout proxy
kubectl -n services rollout restart deployment auth-proxy```

sre_amy: executing. I'll monitor sessions and rollback if we see >5% error spike.

cust_success_maya: I told Optimo & DataLoop we may have a brief auth flapping window ~15m; they acknowledged and are standing by.

legal_jordan: preserve all related logs and evidence — do not purge logs for the next 90 days. Tag this incident for potential customer notification checklist.

sre_amy: rotation complete. Rollout finished, health checks green. Observability: latency normalized, 5xx returned to baseline.

observability_bot: Post-rotation snapshot: 5xx back to baseline, token-reuse metric down 98%. Links: https://grafana.redwood/prod/snapshots/rotation-6323456789

sec_ops_ben: old key revoked: `rbacctl revoke-key --service ingress-token-proxy --key-id old-2026-09-17-01`. Confirmed no new requests with revoked token.

cust_success_maya: customers report service healthy again, Optimo confirmed no data exposure observed on their end.

sre_amy: writing incident summary & follow-ups: 1) tighten token TTL for admin/service tokens, 2) add automated honeypot header to catch scrapers, 3) revisit access logging redaction policy, 4) run full audit of recent token issuance for anomalies.

legal_jordan: note to attach preserved logs to the incident bundle and loop in compliance lead for review.

pagerbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — Priority: P1 -> closed at 10:27 UTC. Follow-up tasks assigned. :white_check_mark:

sre_amy: filing postmortem draft, will ping for reviews. Thanks everyone for quick reaction. :pray:
